item.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
item.description: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

item.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
item.description: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

item.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
item.description: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

item.title: Texas' 15th Congressional District provides clues to state's Latino vote
item.description: The 15th Congressional District runs from the east of San Antonio all the way down into the Rio Grande Valley. This majority-Latino district provides a window into the Latino vote in Texas.

item.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

item.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
item.description: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.
